body.text: {param:pc_title} {param:pc_name}. You have had {param:years} years of us, and we have had {param:years} years of you. I write to tell you that the arrangement is changing, and that you had no part in the decision.
His Majesty's obligations have grown. They did not grow because of anything you did or failed to do out there, which I say partly to spare your feelings and partly because it is true.
What it means for you is this: you will hear from us more often. Not more politely, and not about different matters. Only more often.
I have watched this happen to a dozen colonies, and every one of their governors wrote back to ask whether it was temporary. I will save you the postage.
You have my sympathy, for whatever a Chancellor's sympathy is worth.
You have had better news from me than you deserved for some time. Consider the account settled.

options.text: and thank you for the warning, such as it was
and note you took your time in sending it
and would ask what is left to give
and understand it exactly as it was meant

options.label: acknowledge it, and say nothing more
options.text: The colony has heard the Crown{insert:barb}. It will do what it can.

barb.hateful: , as it always does, at length

options.label: protest that the post is already heavy
options.text: The post from London is the one crop this colony has never wanted for. I ask you to consider what a man can read in a month.

options.label: ask what else is coming
options.text: You have told me what changes this year. Tell me what changes next, and I will build for it.

tone.hateful: I shall expect to write again shortly, and again after that.
